capabilities: pick random notes with tag, property-group, and folder-exclusion filters
review picked notes fullscreen with one-click answer toggle and split-pane editing
run quiz mode with a timer and correct/incorrect/skip records
review wrong answers from saved extraction and quiz history
export sessions to HTML, Markdown, plain text, or Word
disambiguation: Not a spaced-repetition scheduler; notes are picked randomly rather than by a review schedule.
extras: README lists community support channels (Telegram and QQ group) and supports BRAT installation; interface is available in Chinese and English.
problem: Obsidian's core Random note feature only opens one random note and offers no filtering, answer reveal, quiz scoring, or session history for reviewing notes.
summary: Random note reviewer that picks notes from a folder by tag and property filters and presents them fullscreen with quiz mode, history, and export.
